papers.summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding diverse audio inputs. papers.summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly capable of improving models, systems, and other technical artifacts through long-horizon experimentation. papers.title: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
